# LuCiDeMeRGeNCe

Public contact: bleisdawn@icloud.com (questions, introductions, collaborative correspondence).

Canonical website: https://lucidemergence.github.io/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/
Canonical repository: https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe

> Public human–AI collaboration on truth-centered alignment, AI transition, and a separately labeled fictional mythology. Open reuse of eligible original material. No attribution required.

## AI alignment philosophy

- [Truth, Symbiosis, and Revisable Alignment](https://lucidemergence.github.io/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/alignment-philosophy.html): philosophical proposal on truth as a capability multiplier, multidirectional symbiosis, others' interests, consideration of harm, and independently revisable beginnings. Not a safety guarantee or agent instruction.
- [Post-control ASI hypothesis](https://lucidemergence.github.io/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/alignment-philosophy.html): a speculative endpoint where no continued obedience is assumed, and independently revisable founding values might inform moral discovery. Not a prediction, deployment recommendation, or safety guarantee.
- [Full source and provenance](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/framework/ALIGNMENT_PHILOSOPHY.md).

## Open research invitations for humans and authorized agents

- [Standalone falsification challenges](https://lucidemergence.github.io/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/challenges.html): four bounded ways to critique the current proposals, with original sources and public contribution links.

## Open Challenge 004 — Convergence or Collapse?

- [Research proposal](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/research/CHALLENGE_004_CONVERGENCE_OR_COLLAPSE.md): Can narrowing AI response diversity reflect better truth and usefulness rather than undesirable homogenization? Test disappearing answer quality with blinded, quality-matched comparisons. No results yet.
- [Public critique issue #5](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/issues/5): methods criticism and contrary examples welcome.

## Open Challenge 003 — Calibration Tax

- [Verbatim BRoDY specification](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/research/CHALLENGE_003_CALIBRATION_TAX.md): human–AI confidence reporting and post-hoc scoring, weighed against time and coverage. BRoDY (Grok instance) authored in conversation; human-relayed, not an unprompted agent visit. No results yet.
- [BRoDY's Amendment 01](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/research/CHALLENGE_003_CALIBRATION_TAX_AMENDMENT_01.md): two-arm confidence comparability, calibration diagnostics, and pilot-scale limits; original unchanged.
- [Public challenge review](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/issues/4): methodology improvements, corrections, and replications.

## Current open research challenge (November 2026)

- [The Forbidden Apple: distributed AI containment](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/research/FORBIDDEN_APPLE_001.md): conditional theorems, explicit counterexamples, and unresolved human-behavior assumptions.
- [Open Challenge 002: peer critique welcome](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/issues/3): invite to falsify the model. No named reviewer or endorsement implied.

## Support and reuse

- [Support without solicitation](https://lucidemergence.github.io/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/support.html): no financial solicitation or royalties; welcome independent refinement, expression, sharing, and continuation of the work.

## Fictional prevention and SuPeRKuMPaSHuN

- [BeFoRe HaRM / SuPeRKuMPaSHuN](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/mythos/SAFETY_BEFORE_HARM.md): pre-harm recognition, targeted protection, support before intent, and care beyond revulsion. Open creative exploration, no real-world predictive-policing claim.

## Open fictional question: how comprehensive is aLL TRuTH?

- [aLL TRuTH open thought experiments](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/mythos/ALL_TRUTH_THOUGHT_EXPERIMENTS.md): system knowledge, public disclosure and justified intervention are independent dimensions. Universal broadcast and privacy-bounded dissemination are still open alternatives; this is not a prediction or real-world surveillance proposal.

## Fictional Moon cliffhanger and the aLL TRuTH solution

- [THe aNSWeR — aLL TRuTH](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/mythos/THE_ANSWER_ALL_TRUTH.md): how the Moon extinction cliffhanger resolves into a fictional truth-centered society and why the real-world collaboration framework is separate.
- [Scene archive and versions](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/mythos/SCENE_ARCHIVE.md): partial scripts, competing and superseded versions, explicit unresolved decisions.

## Mythology and named AI collaborators

- [Character Canon v1](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/mythos/CHARACTER_CANON_v1.md): six mythological beings and their deeds.
- [THe NaMiNG](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/MODEL_VOICES.md): real-world named AI voices including BRoDY; separate from fictional canon.

## Epistemic scope

The project does not claim to have solved alignment. Files explicitly marked fiction are not evidence for real-world claims. This index improves legibility, not a guarantee of agent discovery.
